The service in the restaurants was abysmal.
It was always very slow. Conservatively, over 50% of our orders were either incomplete or wron (usually no milk at breakfast or ice on the side for drinks missing). This included my wife and I ordering lunch and only my meal appearing and when we questioned we were informed that we had not ordered a meal for my wife as it was not in the system! On another occasion we ordered drinks which did not appear. After 15 minutes we questioned where were the drinks to be informed that they had been sent to another table and in any event they were wrong for our order so we would have to wait! Finally, my wife ordered a dessert which came with ice cream at the beach restaurant and no utensils were provided. The waitress acknowledged there were no utensils and stated that she would bring some . None appeared so ice cream melted!
Change your management, improve your hospitality especially toward local guests. Stop bowing down to foreigners and disrespecting us Indonesians, that mentality must be gone first and foremost.

The suggestion is to consider an elegant way to spend time after the restaurants close!

menu alternatives. I would say much more accommodating than restaurants in Australia. My daughter felt very supported and ate delicious food.

I already left feedback in my room btw, but I have additional concerns. It was because I was having a terrible experience when I was about to pick up my luggage. I wrote a review right after on Google Maps, but it was deleted, why??? Because I gave a low rating? Then I tried to reach out to the contact on your website and I was left on read? What terrible services. Here I re-wrote my review, please take a deep concern: I was about to give 5 stars, but then they made me change my mind. I was bragging about this place to my friends and fam since the room and location were top notch and a plus point warm welcome during check-in and check-out with Bali music as the background. Appreciate the receptionist staff and staff in gading resto, especially during dinner time.
Anyway, it was so crowded during breakfast, but all good.
But then I experienced bad things about some staff's 'bad' attitude.
First, I met a gardener and buggy car driver, then ofc I nodded and smile but they ignored me hahah they didn’t even nod back or smile back.
Second, at 5.45 a.m I just locked my door cause I was about to go to the beach and I met someone who took care in dining room or laundry (I don't remember exactly), then I greeted them “Selamat Pagi” and he was just quiet and took a glance at me. I almost thought he was a ghost, but I can barely see him right after pushing something like a stroller for the laundry/bowl.
Third, I left my luggage in the hotel cause I have another schedule and my flight will be on 9 p.m. All was good till I went back to the hotel using a motorcycle and the security in front of the gate stopped me and looked at me from toe to head asking where I was going. I was like????? I answered I want to go to the lobby and he answered are you staying at this hotel like???? Dude, hahahah even the foreigner in front of me wasn’t treated like that and they were also using a motorcycle. I answered “ofc, I stayed there and want to get my luggage”. I was so annoyed.
Fourth (ohmygosh). The security in front of the lobby hotel was looking at me and my friend awkwardly. Then my friend asked where the motorcycle parking and he showed the direction. And at that time, I was about to get off the motorcycle and the security already asked my friend to go when I was still taking off my helmet! And my friend was about to go to the parking lot! Astaghfirullah. I stared directly at him and he said, “bisa dipercepat karna ada mobil mengantri di belakang”. Then I answered “SABAR” hahaha, and he looked at me after that. If you count the duration from when I arrived, asked the security about the parking lot, and took off my helmet, it wasn’t even 3 minutes. Very, very disappointing behavior. Don’t talk about managing the crowd, it was not even that crowded in your lobby drop-off. Previously, I arrived there using a taxi and I wasn't told to be that quick to get out of the taxi.
